name: nocap-lang
description: A small, readable Gen-Z programming language written in TypeScript.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --types node --skipLibCheck test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
